question: Where can I find the closest science museum in proximity to Parker Manatee Aquarium, Bradenton, FL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE museum ILIKE '%science%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bradenton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' ORDER BY geometry <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Parker Manatee Aquarium%' LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1;
